create_world_logger: create a WorldLogger instance with opt to log actions and observations in a ParlAI world
log_world_acts: call the log method on WorldLogger to record acts from a single or batch world
write_conversations_format: write logged episodes to a file in Conversations format using write_conversations_format
write_parlai_format: write logged episodes to a file in ParlAI text format using write_parlai_format
convert_to_labeled_data: convert a logged episode into labeled data format with text and labels fields
